title: Comments: dragging with the comment tool drags the new comment UI around
reason: Reports a drag gesture moving the new comment composer with the cursor even though comment placement is expected to be a click. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve has no comment-placement tool/composer, so this is not a canvas tool regression in the local editor.

title: Comments: slow Zero query materialization on tldraw.com
reason: The reply attributes a slow comment query to CPU throttling in the preview deployment hosting both replicator and view syncer, closes the issue for now, and asks to monitor after staging deployment with more compute.

varveAssessment.assessment: This is an upstream Zero sync capacity issue; Varve has no equivalent service deployment.

title: Comments are sometimes missing from the comments sidebar
reason: The reporter clarifies that only top-level comments appear on canvas, while the sidebar should represent threads. The replies describe sorting threads by latest activity while continuing to show the first comment; no explicit final closure is recorded.

varveAssessment.assessment: The sidebar/thread distinction belongs to upstream collaboration comments, absent from Varve.

title: Text caret is invisible on empty lines when zoomed out
reason: The issue reports an invisible caret on blank lines at modest zoom. A contributor posts a proposed fork fix, but the thread points them to #7695 and they agree not to push while upstream PR contribution policy is restricted; this is not evidence of a merged fix.

varveAssessment.assessment: Strong text-layout/zoom visual lead, but no Varve reproduction or screenshot replay was performed.

title: Comment clustering sometimes behaves unexpectedly
reason: The author labels this a placeholder and says the midpoint behavior, reproduction steps, and visual evidence still need investigation. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Insufficient source details and no Varve comment clustering feature; no change is indicated.

title: Comments: improve UX on mobile and iPad
reason: The broad request asks for more concrete mobile/iPad problems across pin placement, opening threads, composing, and scrolling. It provides prompts for actionable follow-up but no specific validated defect or comments.

varveAssessment.assessment: No Varve comment feature exists to apply this broad mobile audit request to.

title: Comments: comment UI text isn't translated
reason: The reply says the hardcoded comment UI strings will be fixed when the feature is merged, but the retrieved discussion does not confirm that merge or localization coverage.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve lacks the comment UI; no locale regression is established in the application or marketing site.

title: packages/tldraw is missing @tldraw/state as a declared dependency
reason: Reports strict pnpm isolation failing because upstream `packages/tldraw` imports `@tldraw/state` without declaring it directly. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: The package/dependency graph is specific to upstream SDK package boundaries; no Varve package-resolution failure was reproduced.

title: File pastes drop the html and text clipboard content copied alongside them
reason: Reports that when a clipboard contains a file plus HTML and text, upstream paste chooses only the file before SDK customization hooks can inspect the other flavors. No comments were available.

varveAssessment.assessment: Potential clipboard interoperability regression; Varve's multi-flavor paste arbitration was not source-inspected or reproduced here.

title: Preview deploy pruning misses bemo and CRM durable objects
reason: Reports preview deployment cleanup leaving demo/CRM Cloudflare Durable Objects and possibly workers behind. No comments were available; this is deployment-resource lifecycle work.

varveAssessment.assessment: Varve does not use these Cloudflare Durable Objects or preview workers; no local cleanup defect is indicated.
